concern: Aspiration thrombectomy system with automatic, rapid, repeated onset of pressure change
title: Aspiration thrombectomy system for thrombus removal with aspiration catheter
claims: Claims ( 14 ) A clot removal system, comprising: a catheter (410) having a distal end and defining a lumen filled with a liquid column having a proximal portion and a distal portion; a controllable vacuum valve; a vacuum source (80) fluidically connected to the vacuum valve (420); a controllable vent valve (440) having a vent liquid input; a vent fluid source containing a vent liquid and fluidically connected to the vent valve (440) to retain the vent liquid at the vent fluid input; characterised in that the clot removal system further comprises a manifold connected to the catheter (410), to the vacuum valve (420), and to the vent valve (440), the manifold fluidically connecting the proximal portion of the liquid column in the lumen: to the vacuum source (80) through the vacuum valve (420); and to the vent fluid source through the vent valve (440); a controller (560) connected to the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) and configured to selectively open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) such that: responsive to opening the vacuum valve (420), the vacuum source (80) is fluidically connected to the liquid column in the lumen; and responsive to opening the vent valve (440), the vent fluid source is fluidically connected to the liquid column in the lumen, the controller (560) configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) to: change a level of vacuum at the distal end; and prevent forward flow of the distal portion out from the distal end during each cycle. The system according to claim 1, wherein the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) in a repeated cycle comprising a double-closed state in which the vacuum valve (420) is closed and the vent valve (440) is closed. The system according to claim 2, wherein a time of the double-closed state is no greater than 30 ms The system according to claim 1, wherein the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) in a repeated cycle comprising a vent-only state in which the vacuum valve (420) is closed and the vent valve (440) is open. The system according to claim 4, wherein a time of the vent-only state is no greater than 50 ms. The system according to claim 1, wherein the controller (560) is configured to selectively open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve cycle in a repeated cycle comprising: a vacuum-only state in which the vacuum valve (420) is open and the vent valve (440) is closed; a first double-closed state in which the vacuum valve (420) is closed and the vent valve (440) is closed; a vent-only state in which the vacuum valve (420) is closed and the vent valve (440) is open; and a second double-closed state in which the vacuum valve (420) is closed and the vent valve (440) is closed. The system according to claim 6, wherein a time between an opening of the vent valve (440) and a closing of the vent valve (440) is between approximately 10 ms and approximately 50 ms. The system according to claim 6, wherein a period of the cycle is: between approximately 6 Hz and approximately 16 Hz; or between approximately 8 Hz and 12 Hz. The system according to claim 1, wherein the change in the level of vacuum at the distal end is: greater than approximately 51 kPa (15 inHg) in no greater than approximately 50 ms; or greater than approximately 68 kPa (20 inHg) and no greater than approximately 30 ms; or greater than approximately 85 kPa (25 inHg) and no greater than approximately 20 ms. The system according to claim 1, wherein: the lumen has an internal diameter of between approximately 0.965 mm (0.038") and approximately 2.692 mm (0.106"); and the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) at a frequency of between 2 and 16 Hz. The system according to claim 1, wherein: the lumen has an internal diameter of between approximately 1.73 mm (0.068") and approximately 2.24 mm (0.088"); and the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) at a frequency of between 2 and 16 Hz. The system according to claim 1, wherein the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) in a repeated cycle and prevent forward flow of the distal portion out from the distal end during each cycle by regulating timing of the vent valve (440). The system according to claim 1, wherein the controller (560) is configured to cyclically open and close the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) to retain a level of pressure at the distal end at less than physiological pressure. The system according to claim 1, which further comprises a shaft and the vacuum valve (420) and the vent valve (440) are mounted together on the shaft.
